newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-CBA to outsource technology - paper.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-CBA to outsource technology - paper.

text.p: Commonwealth Bank of Australia (CBA) will soon outsource its core banking technology systems in a deal worth up to A$6 billion over 10 years, the Australian Financial Review reported on Wednesday.
The newspaper said the bank was currently considering the Australian subsidiaries of United States giants Electronic Data Systems and Computing Services Corp for the work.

The companies -- chosen from more than a dozen global providers -- would now provide final pitches which would detail their strategies for the bank's information technology systems, the newspaper said.

"Our objective is to reduce our costs, and particularly to reduce the time to market of new technologies, while reducing the risk of investing in them," CBA corporate relations head Lyndell Fraser was quoted as saying in the paper.
The newspaper said banking analysts estimated that CBA's information technology costs were between A$400 million and A$600 million a year.
